nodes.summary: For a sequence $a_0, a_1, a_2, \dots$ of natural numbers and $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the alternating partial sum of $a$ up to $k$ is the integer $\sum_{j=0}^{k} (-1)^{k-j} a_j$.

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the Morse quadratic form $Q_{k,n} \colon \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ of index $k$ is $C^\infty$.

nodes.summary: Every Hausdorff, second-countable $C^\infty$ manifold $M$ without boundary, modelled on a finite-dimensional real normed space, admits a Morse function $f \colon M \to \mathbb{R}$.

nodes.title: Morse lemma

nodes.summary: If $n \le k$, then the Morse quadratic form $Q_{k,n}$ of index $k$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfies $Q_{k,n}(v) = -\|v\|^2$ for every $v \in \mathbb{R}^n$, where $\|v\|$ is the Euclidean norm of $v$.
nodes.title: The Morse quadratic form when the index is at least the dimension

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the Morse quadratic form $Q_{0,n}$ of index $0$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfies $Q_{0,n}(v) = \|v\|^2$ for every $v \in \mathbb{R}^n$, where $\|v\|$ is the Euclidean norm of $v$.
nodes.title: The Morse quadratic form of index zero

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the Morse quadratic form $Q_{k,n}$ of index $k$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfies $Q_{k,n}(0) = 0$.
nodes.title: The Morse quadratic form vanishes at the origin

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the Morse quadratic form of index $k$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, with coordinates $v_0, \dots, v_{n-1}$, is the function $Q_{k,n} \colon \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ given by $Q_{k,n}(v) = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} \varepsilon_i v_i^2$, where $\varepsilon_i = -1$ if $i < k$ and $\varepsilon_i = 1$ if $i \ge k$. In particular, if $k \ge n$ every coefficient is $-1$.
nodes.title: Morse quadratic form

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
